title: Characteristic function and Esscher transform of a switching Levy model for the temperature dynamic
abstract: In this paper we extend models for the dynamic of the temperatures by considering random switching between Levy noises instead of Brownian motions, with a mean-reverting movement towards a seasonal periodic function. The use of Levy noises allows for jumps, capturing, together with the regime changes, sudden and relatively persistent oscillations in the weather. An approximated close-form expression for the characteristic function of the temperature process under an Esscher transform is given.
